name: sparx — Driving School (Teen)
tagline: A friendly, encouraging template for teen driving schools — book lessons online from day one.
description: A cheerful, safety-first template for a teen driving school — a warm off-white palette with a friendly blue and a sunny coral, rounded and encouraging. Installs a working booking flow: real lessons and packages (intro drive, behind-the-wheel, driver’s ed, permit and road-test prep), patient instructors you book by name, and dual-brake training cars booked alongside them for behind-the-wheel time. Ships as "RoadReady Driving School".
